cause.description: Why its latest try failed; `null` unless it did.

end_reason.description: Why its search stopped, once it has written its result.

train_rmse.description: Of its result's best; `null` before it, or "—" for a failed sweep (ADR-0006).

so_far.description: While it runs, once it has logged a point.

still_improving.description:
Whether its best's Train RMSE fell more than 1 % over the last 10 % of its evaluations;
`null` for a start that ended early, or ran fewer than 2 generations.

best.description:
Its result's raw **Parameters** (ADR-0007), a failed start's best so far included, which
never counts; `null` before its result.

still_improving_change.description:
How much its best's Train RMSE changed over the last 10 % of its evaluations, which
`still_improving` weighs, as a fraction: −0.018 fell 1.8 %. `null` where `still_improving`
is, a failed sweep left either end without one, or an older engine fit it.

seed.description:
Its own seed, from the run's **Search seed**, its topology and its index; `null` before
its result.

start_point.description: Where its search began, raw; `null` before its result.

cost.description: The **Cost** of its best; never shown, but exported.

train_sse.description:
Per protocol, in the dataset revision's order: each the core's raw sum over the points
that scored, unweighted, as are the val sums.

log.description:
Its latest try's **Start log**, as a full path on the platform; `null` before it first goes
out.

job_log.description:
Its latest try's job log, as a full path on the platform: where its scheduler writes it,
named without a look at the Output folder; `null` before it first goes out, or on This
computer before its job has an id there.

top_10.description:
Its topology's **Top 10**, the lowest Train RMSE first, for the band each parameter is
drawn against (ADR-0021).

before.description: Its try before its latest; `null` before its second.

tries.description: Each try it has had, the first first, for the lines that end its logs.

Start.title: Start

StartCause.description: Why a **Failed start** stopped short of its budget.
StartCause.title: StartCause

StartCurve.description:
A start's **Progress curve**, of its latest try: its best Train RMSE so far against
evaluations, at most 64 points its run's coordinator thinned from its **Start log**, the
first and last always among them. A best with no Train RMSE isn't on it.

evaluations.description: Rising, from its first logged generation's.

train_rmse.description: At each of `evaluations`, to 5 significant figures.

StartCurve.title: StartCurve

StartFit.description:
What simulating a start needs, read from the runs database in one query: its raw best
**Parameters**, its topology, its run's **Dataset revision**, and how its worker scored them,
on which engine.

dataset_revision.description: The revision the run fits, pinned at submit.

parameters.description:
The best vector its latest try with one stored, raw as its search left it: 2 per state,
2 per edge, then the sigmoid's a and b, in ln units (ADR-0007). A failed start's is its best
so far, which never counts.

engine.description: The key of the **Engine bundle** that fit it; `null` for one run from a checkout.

StartFit.title: StartFit

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last.

StartLogPage.description:
A page of a try's **Start log**: its whole lines from `after`, or back from `before`, up to
about 512 KB of the file.

path.description: The log, as a full path on the platform; `null` for a start that hasn't gone out.

found.description:
Whether the file is there: a try whose worker hasn't begun has none yet, and an Output
folder that's gone has lost it.

begins.description:
Where its first line begins: `after`, or past a line `before`'s page began in, which the
page before it ends at; 0 once the log is read from its start.

next.description: Where the next page begins: past the last whole line read.

size.description: The file's size as it was read; the log is whole up to `next` once `next` reaches it.

skipped.description:
Whole lines on the page this engine can't read: written by another engine, or longer than
a page.

StartLogPage.title: StartLogPage

StartLogPoint.description:
One log point: the start's first **Generation**, every `log_every_generations`-th, and its
last, with the best so far.

elapsed_s.description: Since the worker began, to the millisecond.

largest_step.description: The largest σ·√Cᵢᵢ over its parameter's range: how far the search still moves.

StartLogPoint.title: StartLogPoint

StartProgress.description:
A running start's latest **Start log** point, as its coordinator last copied it: "so
far".
StartProgress.title: StartProgress

engine.description:
The key of the engine that drew it, this computer's **Host engine**; `null` when it runs
from a checkout.

drift.description: `null` when every protocol's score matches the stored one within rounding.

StartTry.description: One of a start's tries: when it ran, and how it ended.

cause.description: Why it failed; `null` unless it did.

end_reason.description: Why its search stopped, once it has written its result.

scheduler_state.description: The scheduler's own word for how it ended, such as SLURM's `NODE_FAIL`.

ended_at.description: `null` while it runs, or waits to.

StartTry.title: StartTry

StartWatch.description: The watch on a start's latest try: its events come as `StartWatchEvent`s.

try_number.description: The try it watches; 0 for a start that hasn't gone out, whose watch ends at once.

snapshot.description: Its **Live snapshot** now; `null` while it has none.

StartWatch.title: StartWatch

StartWatchEvent.description: What changed in the watched try's files since the last event.

points.description:
The log's new whole lines, oldest first: at most about 512 KB of the file an event, the
rest in the events that follow at once.

next.description: Where in the log the next event's lines begin.

snapshot.description: Its **Live snapshot**, when it was replaced since the last event; `null` when it wasn't.

ended.description: The try has ended, and this is the watch's last event: its result is in `read_start`.

StartWatchEvent.title: StartWatchEvent

edges.description: Each edge as its two states, the lower first, sorted: the order of its edge parameters.

open_states.description:
Its **Open states**, lowest first: one topology each (ADR-0018). A state its symmetry
makes the same as one of these isn't one.

state_graphs.description: One for each state graph asked for, in the order first asked.

measure.description: Set on the one measured step; `null` on the others.

StepTime.description: One step of a connect, in Unix milliseconds.

ended_at.description: `null` while it's the step under way.

StepTime.title: StepTime

config_id.description: The config to fit, as it was last saved: Submit changes none of its settings.

after.description: The last change the desktop saw; `null` for changes from now on.

seq.description:
The latest change now. Events carry the changes after `after`, or after this one when
`after` is `null` or `reset` is set.

reset.description: `after` isn't in this feed any more, or never was: refetch everything.

Template.description: The template whose structure a protocol has, or `custom` (ADR-0003).
Template.title: Template

TimeEvaluationsParams.description:
Submit's time estimate for a config the platform's finished starts haven't timed (#229),
timed as its starts would run on this computer (#508).

dataset.description: The config's dataset, as `read_dataset` read its current revision.

population.description: The config's: each generation's evaluations, scored together.

cpus_per_start.description: The Job defaults': the threads each start scores on.

running_starts.description:
How many of its starts run at once here: on This computer the Running-starts cap; 1 for a
cluster, whose starts run on other computers.

TimeEvaluationsParams.title: TimeEvaluationsParams

TimeFormat.description: How this computer shows the time of day.

twelve_hour.description:
Whether its settings set a 12-hour clock (true) or a 24-hour one (false); `null` when
they leave it to the language and region.

TimeFormat.title: TimeFormat

TooLargeError.description: The reply would exceed the 16 MiB line cap.

TopStart.description: One of a topology's **Top 10**: its finished starts with the lowest Train RMSE.

best.description: Its raw **Parameters** (ADR-0007): the desktop makes them canonical.

TopStart.title: TopStart

Topology.description:
A topology with what its page shows: its rank in its run and in its run's Ranking group,
its starts by state, its arrays, each parameter's spread and its Top 10.

position.description: Where it goes out among the run's topologies, from 0.

provisional.description: Still next or fitting: its best, near best and spread are "so far".

best.description: `null` until one of its starts has finished.

near_best.description:
How many finished starts are **Near best**; `null` without a best, or while the Best
start's Train RMSE is "—" (ADR-0021).

spread.description: `null` while its Top 10 holds fewer than 2 starts.

first_sent_at.description: When its first array went out, in UTC (ISO 8601), as are its other times.

last_ended_at.description:
When one of its starts last ended: once it's complete or failed, when it did. Its pace
and the run's ETA come from these.

rank.description: Its place among the run's topologies, from 1, by `rank` order; `null` without a best.

ranked.description: How many of the run's topologies rank.

group_rank.description:
Its place in its run's **Ranking group**, from 1, as Results' leaderboard and its Best
start's page (`read_group_rank`) rank it; `null` without a best.

group_ranked.description: How many topologies the run's Ranking group ranks.

starts_queued.description: Sent out and waiting at the scheduler.

starts_waiting.description: Not sent out yet: waiting for room in the run's rolling window, or for a Resume.

parameter_spreads.description:
Each parameter's spread, in layout order, `null` for the open state's pair; `null` with
the spread.

arrays.description: In the order they went out.

top_10.description: The lowest Train RMSE first; a start whose Train RMSE is "—" never enters (ADR-0021).

Topology.title: Topology

TopologyArray.description:
An array of the topology's starts that went out: SLURM's array job, or This computer's
job.

number.description: The array's number in the run, from 1.

job_id.description: `null` until the scheduler is known to have taken it.

ended_at.description: When its last task ended; `null` while one is out.

TopologyArray.title: TopologyArray

TopologyBest.description: A topology's **Best start**: its finished start with the lowest Train RMSE (ADR-0006).

train_rmse.description: `null` when a train point's sweep failed: shown as "—".

val_rmse.description: `null` when a validation point's sweep failed, or the run has no validation points.

TopologyBest.title: TopologyBest

TopologyCounts.description: The list for the config's number of states.

topologies.description: Every state graph at each of its open states.

TopologyCounts.title: TopologyCounts

states.description:
The typed numbers of the states that break it: around the loop from its lowest state for
`loop`, else lowest first. For `connected`, every state apart from the open state's piece
(the largest without one). For `loop` with no `loop`, every state of its block.

transitions.description: The transitions that break it, as places in `transitions`.

loop.description:
For `loop`, the shortest loop through more than 4 states in its block, as `states` names
it; `null` for other rules, or when the search for one gave up.

topologies.description:
A page in the order asked for. A topology whose rank moves between pages is listed where
it was then, twice or not at all; the `runs` change says to read it again.

ranked.description: How many of the run's topologies rank: those with a Best start.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last.

TopologyMatch.description: A typed topology's id, or every rule it breaks; never both.
TopologyMatch.title: TopologyMatch

curves.description:
By start index: each start whose latest try's log its coordinator has read, which it does
once it runs, and again once it ends.

next.description: Pass as `after` for the next page; `null` on the last.

after.description: The `next` of the page before; `null` for the first page.

TopologySample.description:
A Random sample: each run draws `count` topologies at submit, from its **Search seed**,
and records the ones it drew (ADR-0017). The config never holds drawn ids.
TopologySample.title: TopologySample

num_states.description:
From 3 to 16; `null` until it's chosen. A new config starts without one, and a save
needs it.

which.description:
Exactly one of All, a Random sample and Specific IDs; a new config starts on a sample of
5.

provisional.description: Still next or fitting: its best, near best and spread are "so far".

near_best.description:

start's Train RMSE is "—" (ADR-0021).

spread.description: `null` while its Top 10 holds fewer than 2 starts.

first_sent_at.description: When its first array went out, in UTC (ISO 8601), as are its other times.

last_ended_at.description:
When one of its starts last ended: once it's complete or failed, when it did. Its pace
and the run's ETA come from these.

fingerprint.description: The key the user was shown; a connect waiting on any other is left waiting.

What the source said, as one line, where ICMM has its words: squeue's error for

version.description: WebKit, WebView2 or WebKitGTK version; `null` if the engine won't say.

states, or 1. Empty otherwise.

bytes_per_start.description: The coordinator’s estimate for one start’s files; `null` until its inputs are known.

evaluations_per_start.description: The evaluation budget rounded up to a whole generation: what each start runs.

Workbook.description: A workbook the Dataset wizard read on this computer (old ADR-0006), or why it couldn't.

name.description: The file's name.

sheets.description: Its worksheets in tab order; none with a problem.
